`inner_height_only`, `inner_width_only`, `maximum_inner_dimension`, and
`top_left_margin_only_clipped`. Using the generator's four-demo-plus-one-query
lesson assembly, I sampled 100 lessons per band. Every rival was refuted in
100/100 easy, 100/100 medium, and 100/100 hard lessons; there were no
`lesson_identifiable` failures, and 1,499 exact unique inputs were observed.
Details and first refuters are retained in
`checks/audit/5e619caf1f27/lesson-rival-probe.json`.

The portable selected-task stage also passed **45 tests**; see
`checks/audit/5e619caf1f27/task-tests/result.json`. An initial direct pytest
invocation failed collection because its ad-hoc environment omitted the required
runtime `PYTHONPATH`; `checks/audit/5e619caf1f27/tests.log` preserves that harness
artifact. The source-bound portable command resolved it and is the result counted
here. This finite lawful-generator census is not proof against undeclared rivals.
No source was changed.

## 5e619caf1f27

**Reproduced semantic-declaration defect; source unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 `88e87cce86c9643944e6b644a7b342e6a5219d5adfda9be74abffa42e24ad999` aliases every `SEMANTIC_RIVALS` entry into `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS`, but five named rules do not fit all six canonical labeled pairs:

- `identity`: 6/6 mismatches
- `fixed_one_cell_frame`: 4/6 mismatches
- `uncapped_inner_minimum`: 1/6 mismatch
- `outer_color_frame`: 6/6 mismatches
- `fill_expanded_box`: 6/6 mismatches

Four declarations do fit all 6/6: `top_left_margin_only_clipped`, `maximum_inner_dimension`, `inner_height_only`, and `inner_width_only`. The combined audit exited 1 even though its task tests reported 25 passing tests; it also warned about a legacy import and a fixed parent-depth path.

Suggested repair: keep only canonical-fitting rules under `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS`; retain plausible partial heuristics under `SEMANTIC_RIVALS`/`LESSON_COMPETITORS`. No audit target files were edited. Reproducer: `checks/audit/5e619caf1f27/semantic_declaration_summary.json`. Full stage report: `checks/audit/5e619caf1f27-combined/checks/5e619caf1f27_audit_semantic_gate.json`.
